caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 AP06288 is paper-linked and sequence-supported, but its cancer-cell activity comment conflicts with the primary HepG2/fibroblast IC50 values.
Primary Figure 8/Results support an 86-aa precursor with a 22-aa leader and 64-aa mature circular peptide; this is preserved rather than normalized into one linear sequence field.
Primary antibacterial activity for this paper is zone diameter/titer/residual activity evidence; no paper-supported MIC table was found for LNS18.
